Author: bezajel
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Decorate your shrine to Joja with these tasteful Solid Gold Morris statues.[/b][/size][/center]
[center]
[/center]
[center][size=4][b]Celebrate his business acumen by commemorating that time he showed up at Pierre's.[/b][/size][/center]
[center]
[/center]
[center][img height=100]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/47104/47104-1780474389-1421348753.gif[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b]Join Us. Thrive.[/b][/size][/center]


[size=4][b]Main Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Lore-friendly for both Joja and Community Centre route[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Multiple variations with iridium or silver accents[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Animated option - I added a joint to his arm so it makes sense[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]AT version retextures Solid Gold Lewis statue, or Deluxe Scarecrow[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]CP version includes letters, dynamic items descriptions and availability, and a special feature that may even help in early game.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[color=#d4d4d8]There are currently 3 versions of this mod. You can install all three, but you only need one. CP version recommended for full functionality.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][b](CP) Solid Gold Morris[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Statues purchasable as stand-alone objects[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Function as scarecrows (can disable in config)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Animated option (can disable in config)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Configurable sentiment towards Joja (set in config - Love them by default)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]. Animation requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Spacecore[/url][/color][/*]
[/list]
[color=#d4d4d8]Where + When to Buy[/color]
[spoiler]
[code]Buy at JojaMart on Sundays. Limit 1 per customer per day.
If you complete the Community Centre and JojaMart closes, Clint will sell them instead.
If you complete the Joja Community Development Form, JojaMart will sell them every day.[/code][/spoiler]
[color=#d4d4d8]Statue Functions and Rarity[/color]
[spoiler]
[code]Some statues are classified as Big Craftables and can be used as Scarecrows.
Other statues are classified as Furniture and can be rotated and animated, but do not function as Scarecrows.

One randomly selected style of statue will be available each day, with some more rare than others.

The different rarity, base price, and functions of each statue:

Solid Gold      | 50% | 10k | Scarecrow
Silver Bow-tie  | 20% | 15k | Scarecrow
Iridium Bow-tie |  5% | 20k | Deluxe Scarecrow (no longer available after CC completion)

Silver Coupon   | 15% | 15k | Animated
Iridium Coupon  | 10% | 15k | Animated

Actual sale prices are affected by profit margin settings and will be:
- 25% higher from vanilla JojaMart before membership is purchased
- 10% cheaper from JojaMart in SVE
- flat price of 8k when sold by Clint[/code][/spoiler]
[color=#d4d4d8]Special Features and Balance[/color]
[spoiler]
[code]Deluxe Scarecrow

The Iridium Bow-tie statue functions as a Deluxe Scarecrow, but may become available earlier in game than the Deluxe Scarecrow is usually unlocked. This variety has the lowest chance of appearing in shops (5%), and is the most expensive (20k). There is an 80% chance it will appear for sale within a year. You can disable scarecrow functionality in the config if you prefer.

Gold and Iridium Bars

All statues can be placed in a Furnace to produce Gold Bars, and in certain cases, Iridium Bars. This can give access to these bars earlier than might be achieved through mining alone. The prices of the statues are balanced to be less than the cost of purchasing equivalent gold ore, but significantly more than the sale price of the Gold (or Iridium) Bars they produce. You can disable the furnace functionality in the config if you prefer.

Inputs, processing times, and outputs:

Furnace       | 1 statue + 1 coal | 3000 mins (about 2 days)
Heavy Furnace | 1 statue + 3 coal | 600 mins (10 hours)

Gold/Silver Statues | 9-10 Gold Bars
Iridium Statues     | 9-10 Gold Bars OR 3-4 Iridium Bars (10% chance in Furnace | 20% in Heavy Furnace)[/code][/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Unzip and place in your Mods folder[/color]

The (CP) version requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]. Animation requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Spacecore[/url]. Statues can be purchased at JojaMart.
The (AT) versions require Alternative Textures to be installed. Change the texture using the paint bucket, purchased from Robin.
